desc: 黄铜机身抽拉多功能出水，陶瓷阀芯冷热调控，电镀工艺持久如新
name: 全身精铜抽拉冷热龙头款

shots.intent: 首屏一秒传达“可抽拉、清洗不受限”的核心卖点，赢得点击与停留。
shots.textZone: 右上方主标题横带承载主标题，下方一行短副标

shots.intent: 一屏总览六大核心卖点，快速建立“功能齐全”的整体认知。
shots.textZone: 每个图标正下方一行短标签

shots.intent: 三张痛点卡片放大日常摩擦，制造“该换一个好龙头”的动机。
shots.textZone: 顶部居中大标题带 + 每卡下方短标签与圆形叉标

shots.intent: 洗脸、洗头、刷牙三个受益场景让买家直接代入产品带来的便利。
shots.textZone: 每卡左侧 55% 文案区：短标题 + 两行说明

shots.intent: 微距呈现精铜机身与厚实镀层，证明材质用料与防锈卖点。
shots.textZone: 一条引线标注两行短标签

shots.intent: 讲清电镀而非喷涂的表面工艺与多层镀层结构，支撑持久如新卖点。
shots.textZone: 炭灰带内白色主标题，白区一行短说明

shots.intent: 同机位“好品 vs 仿品”对比证明镀层平整与防锈差距，强化购买理由。
shots.textZone: 顶部白字主标题，每格下方短标签

shots.intent: 双列工艺步骤图解加质保短句，消除“用久掉色生锈”的顾虑。
shots.textZone: 居中主标题 + 每列标题条 + 编号步骤短句 + 一行质保短句

shots.intent: 剖示重力球回位原理，证明抽拉顺滑回位、不卡顿不松脱。
shots.textZone: 居中主标题 + 两行副标，图卡下方一行短标签

shots.intent: 冷热分区示意讲清陶瓷阀芯的控温逻辑与经久耐用。
shots.textZone: 炭灰带内白色主标题 + 副标，扇区内冷水/热水短标签

shots.intent: 升级底座与老式底座正反对比消除“装不牢”顾虑，收口信任。
shots.textZone: 顶部居中主标题，每面板底部两行短标签

style.backgroundSystem: flat white #FFFFFF pages alternating with light grey #F4F4F4 panels and deep charcoal #3A3A3A section bands; no textured or photographic backdrops
style.iconSystem: thin-line circular outline icons, single uniform stroke weight, black on white; functional diagram colors allowed only inside diagram screens (red #C0392B annotation/hot, blue #3E7BC0 cold, teal #2E9E8F thumbs-up, magenta #C2186B thumbs-down)
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light with soft contact shadows on light screens; lower-key directional light inside charcoal bands and pain scenes; 5500K on lifestyle panels
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimalist monochrome home-improvement ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white background #FFFFFF, light grey panel #F4F4F4, deep charcoal #3A3A3A headlines and section bands, matte black product tone #1A1A1A as visual anchor; neutral temperature; modern geometric sans-serif type only; complete balanced layouts with natural breathing margins, thin-line circular icons and small dash-dot divider motifs; bright even studio lighting with soft contact shadows on light screens and lower-key directional lighting on charcoal bands; stable centered product presentation, functional diagram colors (red #C0392B annotation/hot, blue #3E7BC0 cold, teal #2E9E8F thumbs-up, magenta #C2186B thumbs-down) allowed only inside diagram screens; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no functional diagram colors used outside diagram screens
style.presentationRules: product centered and stable; scene shots at slight low eye-level, infographic screens straight-on flat; macro details shallow DOF; diagrams always line-drawing style, never photorealistic; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: matte stainless-steel sink counter and smooth light stone-look countertop; flat matte graphic surfaces for infographic screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short bold headlines in #3A3A3A (white on charcoal bands) with a small dash-dot divider motif under each headline
